source_revision_boundary: Each run retains its frozen artifact revision. Archived source/class manifests, PID/argv identities are not class-loader CodeSource attestations.

current_operator_provenance.label: fast-scale-verified
current_operator_provenance.comparison: Original x30357/z0/y64 six-chunk footprint; 100/500/1000, four channels capped256; 5s warmup,120s OFF/ACTIVE,one repeat. Same2s scale monitor/jstat10s/JFR profile; a one-time file signal from the unchanged bulk registration poll starts sampling before the first warmup; no ABC JVMs or heavy offline tools running. This is distinct from single-observer three-JVM primary runs.

monitor_startup_signal.stage: before first warmup; no assets acknowledged by this signal

commands: scripts/gradle-dev.sh build -Dct.integration=true runGameTestServer -PgameTestBackend createServerALaunchScript createServerBLaunchScript createServerCLaunchScript createServerPerfLaunchScript

historical_run_acceptance.original_scope: Original procedure only; full-window initial counters absent.

restart.reason: First scale monitor called bulk-status before the console BULKS map was initialized. Objects.requireNonNull(BULKS.get(server)) produced backend_error. Original failure retained; no mod/background/asset error inferred.
command: Restart after initial missing BULKS startup observation; only saved stable windows covered. Initial100 OFF/ACTIVE portions may be UNMEASURED. Parent orchestrator paused only to guarantee stopping observer before server stop; driver and Minecraft uninterrupted.

historical_9258_observation_gap.current100_ACTIVE: Only37 late points/~72s; initial reset not seen; not used for a matched full-phase comparison.
historical_9258_observation_gap.full_six_business_windows: 9258 driver first/final counters retained for all six; do not confuse sidecar gaps with missing driver results.
historical_9258_observation_gap.original_full_DB_counter_windows: UNMEASURED: original first_metrics absent; adjacent phase-final cumulative values are not substitutes.

startup_signal.stage: before first warmup; no assets acknowledged by this signal

current_observation_coverage.earlier_setup: Not substituted for business windows; collection begins after initial registration.

conditions.backend: MySQL 8.4.7 defaults + Redis 7.4.6; local Docker loopback; no injected network latency
conditions.original_geometry_scope: Original actual footprint was 3 x 2 loaded chunks, verified by root separately; original raw benchmark did not save x/geometry. No origin inferred from second-resolution report utc.

method.DB_windows: Plain cumulative status first/last differences where retained. Nominal rates use requested loop duration; capture-time rates retain lower/upper status request/reply bounds. Original full120s first snapshots absent =>UNMEASURED; never subtract neighboring stage-final metrics.
method.monitor_windows: 68 all six post-reset60-point/~118s spans. Retain925100 missingOFF/earlyACTIVE and original100/500OFF gaps;500ACTIVE only original24-point late tail, no interpolation.
method.count_and_flow: All registered/loaded/active status counts reflect endpoint eligibility/modes, not positive service at every individual receiver; scale output ledger is aggregate. Actual amount totals are preserved, and there is no traced per-input E2E or independent SQL/local/WAL conservation audit in this scale driver.
method.mod_tick: tick_ms comes from Metrics.tick(RuntimeService.tick elapsed), last-at-most2048 values. Serious new main-thread mod time regressions preserved; this is not whole-Minecraft MSPT.
method.other_timers: delivery_ms dispatch-to-credit publication and sql_ms whole backend worker job elapsed are bounded rings; batches change job work per sample. They are neither chest E2E nor single SQL-statement latency.
method.native_Minecraft: mc_recorded_tick_ms_avg100 from MinecraftServer.getAverageTickTimeNanos/1e6 is last100 recorded tick-work average with unknown window age. Original perf has none =>native before/after comparisonUNMEASURED. mc_target_ticks_per_second=20 is not measured actual TPS.
method.statement_WAL: db_statements counts this JVM Sql-helper query/update attempts, distinct from account statement/sql events and JDBC controls. Original Sql-helper/WAL counters unmeasured. Never sum SQL/WAL/local mirrored assets.
method.counter_attempts: Attempt and commit snapshots can straddle in-flight transactions, so their window-difference subtraction is not a failure count.
method.CPU_heap_GC: Only real process/jstat snapshots within selected counter windows; no full-phase CPU/heap attribution. CPU includes all JVM threads, heap includes uncollected objects, GCT includes concurrent elapsed work rather than STW pause distribution.
method.RCON: Single Python observer for each report. Minecraft shared console response buffer lacks request-body nonce; protocol IDs alone do not prove body attribution. Original business raw replies were not retained; monitors retain rawstatus/bulk replies. Passive sidecars and driver active commands are separate clients. No incorrect FE amount/time is proven; count/error guards and aggregate ledgers are preserved, but complete per-event attribution cannot be reconstructed.
method.scientific_fields: Historical primary/monitor exponent-valued tiny floating fields were excluded; old scale parser could truncate mantissas. They remain unmeasured/excluded rather than rewritten. Plain integer DB/FE/error counters and ordinary decimal timer fields reported here are unaffected. Current driver accepts complete exponents/exact large integers.
method.observer_restart: Historical925 only;68 observer startup uses one-time file signal from existing bulk registration poll before first warmup; no925 failure reassigned to68.
